items.title: Foldy - 'Save the moments' torn-edge photo stack pitch
items.description: A Foldy feature pitch: red photo icon and 'Save the moments - Save photos from a day worth remembering, filed under the day it happened on.' A torn-edge photo stack (two dogs, a mountain, a bridge) spills over a dimmed phone showing the day list. The physical-photo metaphor makes digital memories feel kept, not stored.

items.title: Pomodoro Topics - green list of named, coloured timers
items.description: The Pomodoro app's 'Topics' screen in a green theme: a 'New topic' pill, then topic cards Coding (120m/3m/10m, 2 timers), Default (120m/5m/15m, 4 timers) and Math (120m/1m/15m, 3 timers), each with its shape glyph and tint. A yellow 'Name, color and shape' chip and a Focus/Short-break/Long-break strip with a Settings pill close it. The list reads as a palette of habits.

items.title: Pomodoro Focus - hairline ring, topic menu and up-next break
items.description: The Pomodoro app's 'Focus' screen in green: a hairline progress ring around '120:' with a topic dropdown open (Coding, Default, Math selected, Testing, Work, plus New topic / Topic settings). Play / reset / skip controls sit above 'Up next 01:00 Short break' and a Timer / stats / settings pill. The ring and the up-next line keep the method visible.

items.title: Foldy - 'New Sidebar Navigation' pitch with a friendly folder mark
items.description: A Foldy release pitch: a hand-drawn folder character above a yellow 'New Sidebar Navigation / Foldy Field Notes 1.0' banner, with an arrow pointing to a dark sidebar showing '00:45 / Friday, September 18' and a month grid, then nav rows Today, Calendar (active), Habits, Notes, Moments, Inbox. The cartoon mark softens a navigation announcement.

items.title: Travel app - 'Every trip, one place' light and dark onboarding
items.description: A travel-app montage in light and dark: a splash with a camera glyph, an onboarding card 'Every trip, one place.' over fanned destination photos (Kyoto, Lisbon), and 'Your next trip starts here.' with Continue. The paired themes show one system in both modes; the photo-led cards sell wandering over planning.

items.title: Travel app - upcoming trips shelf with Kyoto and Lisbon cards
items.description: The same travel app's home in light and dark: 'Upcoming' shelves stack destination cards - Kyoto, Japan and Lisbon, Portugal - each a photo with a price tag and a 'days' chip, above a camera FAB. The cards are the itinerary; the two themes confirm one design system.

items.title: Travel app - 'Built for how you actually travel' route-and-collage pair
items.description: More of the travel montage: 'Built for how you actually travel.' shows a map with photo pins joined by a route line; 'Less planning. More going.' shows a scattered photo collage. Light and dark variants repeat with Next / Get Started. The route-of-photos idea frames trips as lived paths, not itineraries.

items.title: US property detail - villa hero, spec tiles and 'Start offer'
items.description: A light 'Property Details' screen: a photographic hero of a white villa with blue shutters, 'Loft Queens Boulevard / New York, USA / 4.5 / $289,000', spec tiles (3 Bedrooms, 2 Bathrooms, 2k sqft), a Description paragraph, Location, and 'Schedule visit' + blue 'Start offer' buttons. The same listing as IMG-0435; the photo hero and price do the selling.

items.title: US property filters - type chips and a blue price histogram
items.description: A 'Filters' sheet for the property app: All/Buy/Rent/Sale segmented control, 'House Type' chips (All, House, Apartment, Villa, Cottage), a 'Price Range' blue histogram with a dual-handle slider ($60K-$950K), and 'Location' (Manhattan, USA). Reset and blue Apply close it. The histogram makes the price filter tangible.

items.title: Ride-hailing destination search - London map with 'Find Rides'
items.description: A ride-hailing search over a London map (H10 London Waterloo, Conquest Tower, Borough Rd): a 'WHERE TO / Destination' sheet with 'Search for a place...' and Home / Work / Airport chips above a black 'Find Rides' button. The map context plus saved-place chips make destination entry one tap.

items.title: Schedule editor - fixed-times vs intervals for a Liverpool route
items.description: Two phones showing an 'Edit schedule' form for 'Liverpool': a schedule-type toggle (Fixed times / Intervals), fields for start/end times (08:00-04:00), first/last departure and a duration row (7 days / 14 days / Endless), closing on Cancel and a green 'Save changes'. The pair compares the two scheduling modes side by side.

items.title: Add Card - nickname field and green Add Card button
items.description: The tail of the 'Add Card' form: a 'Nick Name (optional)' input prefilled 'Work card' above a full-width green 'Add Card' button, inside a device frame. A minimal closing fragment of the payment form seen in full in IMG-0393.
